description.p: Beifahrer lets an AI agent work in your own browser, with your own sessions and the tab you are looking at, instead of in a separate automated one.
Beifahrer lässt einen KI-Agenten in deinem eigenen Browser arbeiten, mit deinen Sitzungen und dem Tab, den du gerade ansiehst, statt in einem separaten automatisierten Browser.
A browser extension talks to a local MCP bridge. Every site is covered by a policy you set, and anything the policy does not allow is refused.
Eine Browser-Erweiterung spricht mit einer lokalen MCP-Brücke. Jede Website unterliegt einer Richtlinie, die du festlegst; was sie nicht erlaubt, wird abgelehnt.

ul.li: Works in Firefox and Chromium-based browsers
Funktioniert in Firefox und Chromium-basierten Browsern
Per-site policy: allowed, ask first, or forbidden
Richtlinie pro Website: erlaubt, nachfragen oder verboten
Confirmation prompts for actions you have not pre-approved
Bestätigungsdialoge für Aktionen ohne Vorab-Freigabe
Local only: the bridge runs on your machine
Nur lokal: Die Brücke läuft auf deinem Rechner

ul.li: Three feature rows (hidden downloads, page requests, file upload) showed a placeholder instead of their icon; fixed
After taking a hidden download, Firefox no longer leaves a tab open on the deleted file
The German app name is now part of the app description
On a Mac, closing the window keeps Beifahrer running; click its Dock icon to bring the window back
On a Mac, the Safari row now shows whether the extension is on instead of staying on Unknown
The app says when a second, outdated pairing file is left over from an earlier version
On a Mac, the app brings the Safari extension along; turn it on in Safari's settings if you want to use Safari
An agent can put a file from a folder you allowed into an upload field on a page
Safari keeps answering after many calls in a row
The toolbar icon in Safari follows light and dark mode once a Beifahrer page opens
In Safari, the options page says where to allow screenshots and hides what Safari cannot do
A simpler toolbar icon that stays recognisable at small sizes
Your default browser comes first when setting up the extension
Firefox installs the extension in Firefox itself, not in whichever browser opens links
The Browser page shows for each browser whether the extension is installed and connected
Connection diagram: every name centred under its picture, all on one line
"This app" label easier to read in dark mode
Toolbar button in the browser's icon colour in Chrome and Edge too
Toolbar button in the same colour as the browser's other icons, on light and dark toolbars
Connection diagram moved from the extension popup to its settings page; the popup is compact again
Toolbar button without a badge: the bus stays fully visible, a coloured dot shows the state
Extension popup and settings work again in Firefox: settings link, connection diagram, all sections
Settings page shows the coloured app icon and working privacy and legal notice links
Status page reads the status text first, with more space around the diagram
Connection diagram on the status page: shows the agent, Beifahrer and the browser, with link states and fix hints
Popup diagram for the extension, with a coloured app icon in the header
Autostart refusal is now reported instead of being saved silently
One app per system: the window and the command line for coding agents are in the same package
Setup assistant in the window: pick your coding agent, review the change to its config and confirm it; the old file is backed up first
The macOS app and the Windows installer no longer collide with a second Beifahrer package
The macOS app is signed and notarised and comes as a disk image
The site links to the developer
The About window links to the privacy policy and the legal notice
Reading a page works again after the first call in the same tab
Long warnings and row titles in the extension wrap instead of being cut off
The desktop app now also runs on Windows and macOS
Agents can download a file a page links to and see whether it finished
Clicking a file link downloads it once instead of twice
New app and extension icon: a VW bus instead of the sparkles
About dialog with a Support link
Scripts get their own switch in the per-site policy, and you can stop script prompts
New beifahrer doctor command to check the setup
Desktop app: Browser and Agent pages with the pairing token and connect snippet
